title: Minimum amount of sum payable
description: The minimum amount of sum payable is not less than twenty-five per cent. of the value of such defective goods sold or service provided

content.general_rule: The District Commission can pay such sum as may be determined by it if it is of the opinion that loss or injury has been suffered by a large number of consumers
content.exception: The minimum amount of sum so payable shall not be less than twenty-five per cent. of the value of such defective goods sold or service provided
conditions: loss or injury has been suffered by a large number of consumers who are not identifiable conveniently

user_queries: what is the minimum compensation amount
